subject: Medisphere — post-demo next steps & artifact delivery roadmap
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Soto <alex.soto@medisphere.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Medisphere — post-demo next steps & artifact delivery roadmap

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate you walking us through the clinical workflows. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the key asks you raised and propose an artifact delivery roadmap so procurement/security can evaluate and move us toward a pilot decision.

Quick recap of asks you called out:
- SOC 2 report (Type II preferred) or at minimum SOC 2 readiness evidence
- High-level pen test summary and whether remediation is in progress
- Short sample of audit logs (sanitized) showing retention / access patterns
- Documentation on data retention / deletion policy for PHI/PII
- Clarify procurement/PO process & economic buyer timeline

Proposed artifact delivery roadmap (dates are suggested but flexible):
- By Nov 10: SOC 2 report (or SOC 2 request template we can fill) + pen test summary
- By Nov 14: Sanitized audit logs sample + retention policy doc
- By Nov 17: Finalized mutual action plan / PO template landed with procurement (if ready)

Can you confirm the procurement contact and economic buyer for final approval? On the call you mentioned Mark Liu (CISO) and a central procurement inbox — is procurement@medisphere.com the correct intake? Also, your timeline note that internal procurement review finishes ~Nov 20 — is that still accurate? That will drive whether we rush artifacts or also schedule a joint security review.

Attachments: SOC2_request_template.pdf (attachment stub)

Next steps proposed:
1) You confirm internal reviewers + deadlines
2) We deliver initial artifacts (SOC2/pen test summary + sanitized logs) for review by Nov 10–14
3) If needed, schedule a 30-min security sync with Mark and our security lead (Laura) the week of Nov 13

If you prefer, we can also redline the PO template once your procurement team shares it.

Thanks — I’ll hold the dates flexible to match your review cadence.

—
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@medisphere.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medisphere.com>, Mark Liu <mark.liu@medisphere.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Nov 2028 13:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Medisphere — post-demo next steps & artifact delivery roadmap

Connor — thanks for the write-up and the clear timeline. Confirming: procurement@medisphere.com is the right intake and Mark Liu (CISO) will be the primary security reviewer. Our economic buyer is Maria Delgado (SVP of Digital Ops); I’ll introduce her once procurement gives the green light.

A few clarifications from Mark and procurement on the call:
- SOC 2: we need Type II report if you have one. If not, provide your SOC 2 controls matrix and timeline to Type II.
- Pen test: we do not need raw findings, but a 1–2 page executive summary showing scope, date, and remediation status is sufficient.
- Audit logs: must be sanitized to remove any patient identifiers. A CSV sample with column names and a short readme is preferred.
- Retention: please specify retention by data class (PHI, PII, app logs) and deletion workflow for pilot data.

Timing constraints: Procurement wants to complete initial compliance checks by Nov 20 to be eligible for December procurement window. If Redwood can deliver the SOC2 docs and sanitized logs by Nov 10–14, that keeps us on pace.

I’m attaching our standard PO intake template for your legal to review.

Attachments: Medisphere_PO_template_v2.docx (attachment stub)

Alex Soto
Director, Digital Innovation
Medisphere Health
alex.soto@medisphere.com | +1 617-555-2210

Date: Sat, 04 Nov 2028 10:02:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Medisphere — post-demo next steps & artifact delivery roadmap

Alex / Mark / Procurement — thanks for confirming. Quick update on what we can deliver and owner mapping from Redwood: 

Deliverables and owners (Redwood):
- SOC 2 artifacts: Laura Bennett (Security Lead) will provide the controls matrix and the latest SOC 2 report or readiness evidence. Target: Nov 10.
- Pen test exec summary: Security/Infra team will provide a one-page summary including scope, date, and remediation status. Target: Nov 10.
- Sanitized audit logs sample + readme: We will prepare a CSV with column names and readme showing how logs are retained and access is audited. Target: Nov 14.
- Data retention / deletion policy: We will provide a short policy doc and deletion workflow for pilot data. Target: Nov 14.

Internal contacts:
- Security reviewer (Redwood): Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
- Account lead: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
- Commercial lead: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Next steps:
1) I’ll send the SOC2 and pen test summary by Nov 10 to procurement@medisphere.com and mark.liu@medisphere.com.
2) We’ll deliver sanitized logs + retention policy by Nov 14.
3) Laura is available for a 30-min security sync the week of Nov 13 — propose Wed Nov 15 11:00am ET if that works for Mark.

If procurement wants earlier copies, let us know and we’ll prioritize. Also, please send Maria Delgado’s contact if you want the econ buyer looped earlier.

Attachments: pen_test_scope_summary.pdf (attachment stub)

—
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 07 Nov 2028 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Medisphere — post-demo next steps & artifact delivery roadmap

Vivek / Connor — quick internal note after prepping the artifacts: 

Status update (internal only):
- SOC 2: We have the controls matrix ready and the last Type II report available — I will redact customer identifiers and export a copy suitable for Medisphere. ETA Nov 10 morning.
- Pen test summary: Completed; need one more sign-off from infra. I’ll attach the exec summary when signed off. ETA Nov 10 EOD.
- Audit logs sample: We have to sanitize logs for PHI/PII; I’ve asked infra to run the sanitization script and produce a CSV + readme. ETA Nov 14.
- Retention policy: Drafted — will convert to customer-friendly PDF with the deletion workflow. ETA Nov 14.

Action items:
- Connor: confirm Wed Nov 15 11:00am ET (Mark’s calendar permitting) for security sync.
- Vivek: prepare commercial play (pilot terms + any short-term discount considerations) in case procurement pushes for quicker sign-off.
- Laura (me): deliver artifacts to procurement@medisphere.com and CC Mark by Nov 10/14 as noted.

I’ll also include a short readme in the Drive folder that explains what is sanitized and what is redacted. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-medisphere-evidence

—
Laura Bennett
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
